Annual leave is accrued at the rate of one and two-thirds days for each completed month of service. Employees may carry a maximum of ten days of accrued leave across a financial year, and any balance above that ceiling is paid out in the first pay cycle of the new year.

Requests for annual leave must be submitted at least fourteen days before the intended start date. A manager may approve a shorter notice period where operational requirements allow. Leave taken without an approved request is recorded as unpaid absence.

Purchase orders above ten thousand dollars require two approvals, one of which must be from a delegate of the finance team. Orders below that threshold require a single approval from the requesting employee's direct manager.
